about: Multinomial Naive Bayes over in-word character 1-4-grams (lowercase, NFC, each word padded with spaces; grams with a digit or no letter are skipped). Weights: log probabilities, uint8-quantised over [lo, hi], row-major langs x (grams + 1); the last column is every gram not in the list. prior: log prior per language, added to the score.
